research.title: Image Preprocessing for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned NumPy preprocessing routines to crop inspection images, normalize grayscale intensities, and preserve corresponding surface defect labels.
Checked processed samples against reference images and documented label mismatches and inconsistent dimensions for review before baseline classifier evaluation.

work.title: Order Processing and Inventory Coordination
bullets: Reviewed incoming order paperwork for completeness, maintained shipment records, and routed discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Reconciled stock count sheets with inventory logs, coordinated routine supply requests, and prepared handover notes for outstanding deliveries.

projects.title: Traffic Sign Classification with Gradient Features
bullets: Implemented a baseline traffic sign classifier using histogram of oriented gradients features and a linear support vector machine in scikit-learn.
Evaluated predictions on a held-out image split and inspected confusion patterns among signs with similar shapes under varying illumination.
